BD-F07

Large Adjustable Ball Valve Lockout

Category: Valve Lockout Equipment

  • Fast dispatch from stock, same-day shipping
  • LOTO solution compliant with OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147
  • Special per-unit pricing on bulk orders
Get information Request a quote

Product Details

Used on large-diameter lines, the BD-F07 is designed to lock ball valves from DN70 to DN200. It adjusts to handle widths from 2 4/5 inch (73 mm) to 8 1/2 inch (215 mm) and is used especially on double-cylinder and raised ball valves.

The high-temperature-resistant, high-strength polypropylene (PP) body keeps working on hot process lines as well. Since the width can be adjusted to the right and left, it fits different valve types. Locked with different types of safety padlocks, it prevents unauthorized opening of manual quarter-turn handles and keeps isolation on large lines under lock.

  • DN70-DN200: Suitable for large-diameter ball valves.
  • Wide Handle Range: Adjusts to handle widths between 73 mm and 215 mm.
  • Heat-Resistant PP: The high-strength polypropylene body withstands high temperatures.
  • Dual Cylinder Compatibility: Can be used on double-cylinder and rising-stem valves.
  • Opening Prevention: Prevents unauthorized opening of quarter-turn valve handles.
